title: 2 Hour Sunset Waterway Excursion in Calabash
includes: Onboard restroom and plenty of seating
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Comfortable Clothing: Dress in layers for changing temps.
Non-Slip Shoes: Closed-toe shoes help keep you safe on deck.
Sun Protection: Sunscreen, sunglasses (polarized are best!), and a hat.
Rain Gear: A light jacket or windbreaker, just in case.
Snacks & Water: Bring your own or purchase onboard.
Small Cooler: Optional for drinks or snacks.
Camera or Smartphone: For amazing sunset photos!
Seasickness Medication: If needed, take it before departure.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Set sail with Calabash Fishing Fleet on a peaceful 2‑hour Sunset Waterway Excursion, the perfect way to experience the natural beauty of the Calabash River and Intracoastal Waterway. As the sun dips toward the horizon, watch the sky burst into shades of gold, pink, and orange from the comfort of a modern, spacious vessel.

Bring your friends, your family, or your special someone and let the calming coastal breeze set the mood. With an attentive crew handling every detail, all you need to do is sit back, relax, and enjoy an unforgettable evening on the Carolina coast.
